name: Shougang source-derived voxel environment

geometry.surface: opaque exposed cube faces; same-color greedy rectangles; right-handed outward winding

provenance.method: Opacity/scale-filtered original Gaussian centers grouped into uniform world-grid voxels; alpha-weighted DC color quantized to fixed night palette; remove isolated cells and components smaller than6; fill single-cell holes with4+occupied neighbors; reapply latest road clearance; greedy exposed-face meshing; display colors subsequently restored from original source DC by world-voxel resampling, replacing the legacy 16-color night display palette.
provenance.appearanceDifference: This is a derived opaque voxel reconstruction. It is not Gaussian rendering and does not preserve view-dependent SH colors or sub-voxel detail.

paletteRole: Legacy geometry segmentation reference only; current vertex colors are restored source DC, not limited to this palette.
